title: Surface policy inspection reads files on an async worker
wanted_capability: Keep filesystem-backed policy discovery and evaluation on the blocking pool so MCP diagnostics cannot block asynchronous workers.
notes: Source fix 15ad54b0 removes the obsolete synchronous-handler exemption and types the supported action values. Deployment and live regression checks are pending.
resolution_note: Deployed source 769b1241c326. MCP surface inspection now executes blocking policy/filesystem work through run_blocking, with typed actions and rejection of unknown fields. Live invalid actions/unknown fields returned invalid-params; readonly replay preserved 31 visible tools. Eight focused tests and full clippy/concurrency gates passed. Response-budget audit remains separate.
